source_text.body:
Scale ML innovations across ads ranking models with AI agents
Meta engineering describes using AI agents to help scale ML innovations across its ads ranking models; the post gives only the headline.
·
Nov 22, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Agents share a knowledge base of past training runs and handle technique propagation in three stages. They rank technique-model candidates, adapt techniques to each model, and ship them by launching and monitoring multi-day training runs, recovering from failures, and reallocating compute. For top-revenue models, agents learn from engineers' first adaptations, then propose the rest. Engineers approve plans and set priorities.
How it went
Meta estimates agents handle over 60% of propagation since March 2026. Early results show 3x engineer productivity, a median 4x training compute reduction on select combinations, and an estimated $45M+ in compute savings by year end.
Worth knowing
This builds on standardized model templates and a prior investment in automation; the biggest-revenue models still need engineer-led adaptation, and all shipping requires online A/B wins and human approval.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
In my repository at [path or repo name], I have a model improvement that worked on [model A, e.g. a ranking model]: [short description of the change]. Find other models in the codebase with a similar structure, such as [model B, model C], and propose how to apply the same change to each one. Make the changes on a new branch, run the existing tests, and stop with a summary of which models changed and which results need my review. Pause and show me the plan before editing any files or pushing anything.
Original source: https://engineering.fb.com/2026/11/18/ml-applications/ai-agents-to-scale-ml-innovations-across-ads-ranking-models/
